newsitem.title: USA: Hills sees further gross margin improvement.
newsitem.headline: Hills sees further gross margin improvement.

text.p: Hills Stores Inc said Wednesday it is confident its improvement in its gross margins can continue.
The company said it saw a 60 basis point first quarter improvement in its gross margin rate.

Hills said it was able to improve its operating results despite a "flattish" sales trend. It cited the elimination of an ad circular, an earlier Easter, and "less-than-favorable" weather after Easter for a decline in first quarter sales.

The company reported net sales for the quarter of $353.5 million, down from $370.2 million a year earlier. Its quarterly net loss amounted to $0.95 per share compared to a loss of $1.45 per share for the same period a year ago. The year-ago loss included a charge of $0.71 per share.
